html:
We go beyond walls and furniture — creating interiors that feel like home and inspire every day.

TOP INTERIOR DESIGN FIRM

Top Interior Design, Best Architecture And Best Scientific Vastu Firm in India: Crafting Stories Behind Every Space

We are proud to be recognized as the top interior design firm in India, trusted by homeowners and businesses alike. Our strength lies in our approach, combining creativity and functionality to create environments that are beautiful to live in and work in. We will take your space from ordinary to extraordinary and create inspirational spaces using our years of experience and a committed team of designers, architects, and artisans. Lastly, what sets us apart from other design firms is our ability to capture your lifestyle and turn it into a design that is really “you.”

Meet Our Creative Team

The Visionaries Behind the Designs

Mamta Verma

Manager

Ibaanca Kapoor

Interior designer

Khushi Rai

Interior designer

Mudassir

3D Visualiser

Our Story

9th Corner, registered as Ninth Corner Dream Designs Private Limited, is an interior design firm that has been designing homes, workplaces and commercial spaces for 22 years. In that time we have delivered more than 800 spaces, from compact city apartments to villas, farmhouses, offices, showrooms and salons. Today we are a full-service interior design firm with our head office in Pitampura, Delhi, and a branch in Gurgaon.

Our approach is to capture your lifestyle and turn it into a design that is really you. We combine creativity with functionality, so the spaces we create are as practical to live and work in as they are beautiful to look at.

A Word From Our Director

Our director, Rahuul Guptaa, leads the company. His belief is simple: design is about shaping experiences, not just filling rooms. Every project is a collaboration with the client, and every space should tell the story of the people who use it. That conviction guides how our whole team works, from the first conversation to the final handover.

What We Do

We are an interior design firm with architecture, furniture design and project management under one roof. Our core services are:

  • Residential interior design for apartments, builder floors, villas and farmhouses. Learn more.
  • Architecture for new buildings, extensions and renovations. Learn more.
  • Commercial interior design for offices, showrooms and retail spaces. Learn more.
  • Furniture design, with custom pieces and joinery made for each project.
  • Hospitality and salon interiors that balance experience with operations. Learn more.
  • Vastu guidance built into planning from the very first layout.

How We Work

Every project follows the same disciplined sequence: a detailed brief, space planning, concept design, photorealistic 3D visualisation, working drawings, material selection, procurement and supervised execution. Clients see their space before it is built, and changes are made on screen rather than on site. Our pricing is transparent and milestone-based with no hidden costs. Timelines are fixed, and our work is backed by a 10-year warranty.

Our Core Values

  • Dependable: we stand by our word and deliver on our promises.
  • Committed: every project is handled with dedication to quality and creativity.
  • Reliable: from small details to the grand vision, our clients can count on timely execution.
  • Involving the client: great design is a collaboration, so clients take part in every step.
  • Consistency: every project meets the same high standards of design and execution.

The Numbers Behind Our Work

Twenty-two years of practice, more than 800 spaces delivered, a 98% client retention rate and a 4.8 Google rating. For an interior design firm, these numbers matter because they show that clients trust us, come back to us and recommend us. We are proud of every one of them, and we work to earn them again on each new project.

Our Team

Our team brings together interior designers, architects, 3D visualisers, project managers and artisans. Because design and execution sit within one interior design firm, nothing gets lost between the drawing and the finished room.

Projects We Are Proud Of

Our portfolio includes private residences across Delhi NCR and beyond, such as the Rana Residence, Sachin Residence and Virendra Residence, as well as commercial work like the Hannu Office and Star Salon, and the luxury interiors of Luxuria. Each one began with a conversation about how the space would be used and ended with a finished space that matched the approved design. You can browse every completed project on our projects page.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • A designer who listens first and draws second.
  • A clear view of your space in 3D before any work begins.
  • A quote you can understand, broken into milestones.
  • Regular updates and a fixed timeline.
  • A finished space backed by a 10-year warranty.

Why Clients Choose an Integrated Interior Design Firm

Working with separate architects, designers and contractors often means gaps between drawings and reality, and nobody fully responsible when something goes wrong. Choosing one interior design firm for planning, design and execution gives you a single team, a single schedule and a single point of accountability from the first meeting to the final handover.

Where We Work

From our head office in Pitampura and our Gurgaon branch, we work across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Chhattarpur, Hauz Khas, Rajokri, Pitampura and Karnal. See our service areas for details.

Start Your Project

Whether you are planning a new home, refreshing an office or opening a salon, we would love to hear about it. Browse our projects, explore all our services, or book a free consultation with an interior design firm that designs, builds and stands behind its work.
